SETTINGS.TITLE: Messenger templates
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Save reusable Messenger scripts with dynamic variables. Load them in the simulator or export them from a conversation with the real contact details.
SETTINGS.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load your templates. Check your connection and try again.

EMPTY.TITLE: No templates yet
EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: A template stores a fictional Messenger script. Add variables such as the contact name or a custom attribute and they are filled in when you export from a conversation.

NO_RESULTS.TITLE: No templates found
NO_RESULTS.DESCRIPTION: No template matches “{query}”. Try a different title.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete template
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: “{title}” will be removed for everyone in this account. This cannot be undone.

SETTINGS.DELETE_ERROR: We could not delete the template. Try again.
SETTINGS.DUPLICATE_ERROR: We could not duplicate the template. Try again.

EDITOR.DESCRIPTION: Write the script once. Variables are replaced with real data when you export the template from a conversation.
EDITOR.NOT_FOUND: This template no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

NAME.LABEL: Template title
NAME.REQUIRED: Add a title so you can find this template later.
NAME.TAKEN: You already have a template with this title. Choose a different one.

EDITOR.INVALID: Add a title, a business name and at least one valid message before saving.
EDITOR.DEFINITION_ERROR: Fix the highlighted messages before saving.
EDITOR.COPY_SUCCESS: Copy saved as a new template.
EDITOR.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save the template. Check your connection and try again.

UNSAVED.TITLE: Leave without saving?
UNSAVED.MESSAGE: You have unsaved changes in this template. They will be lost.

EDITOR.DRAFT_RESTORED: We restored the draft you had open.
